title: tips¶
content:
tips¶

A collection of tip mobjects for use withTipableVMobject.

Classes

ArrowCircleFilledTip

Circular arrow tip with filled tip.

ArrowCircleTip

Circular arrow tip.

ArrowSquareFilledTip

Square arrow tip with filled tip.

ArrowSquareTip

Square arrow tip.

ArrowTip

Base class for arrow tips.

ArrowTriangleFilledTip

Triangular arrow tip with filled tip.

ArrowTriangleTip

Triangular arrow tip.

StealthTip

'Stealth' fighter / kite arrow shape.
